# High-risk paths. A PR touching any of these needs Mika's `human-reviewed` label.
#
# Read by .github/scripts/risk_tier.py at the PR's BASE commit, so a PR can't loosen
# the list it is judged by. Patterns use fnmatch: `*` also crosses `/`, and matching is
# case-sensitive, hence the [Cc] classes on agent-instruction files.
#
# A file on this list is high even if it also matches .github/low-risk.txt.
# A file on neither list is high too. See low-risk.txt.

# --- CI and this gate -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Workflows decide what runs with the repo's token; the scripts and lists are the gate.
.github/*
.githooks/*

# --- Image, runtime and server ----------------------------------------------------------
# What the container runs as, what nginx serves, and anything executable.
Dockerfile
.dockerignore
compose*.yaml
docker/*
artisan
*.sh
public/index.php
public/.htaccess
*.htaccess

# --- Boot and config --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Service providers, middleware stacks, credentials and the asset build.
bootstrap/*
config/*
.env*
*/.env*
secrets/*
vite.config.*

# --- Routes, auth, admin, scheduled jobs ------------------------------------------------
# Who can reach what, and what runs without anyone asking.
routes/*
app/Admin/*
app/Http/Middleware/*
app/Providers/*
app/Console/*

# --- Schema -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Migrations and seeders change or wipe real data.
database/migrations/*
database/seeders/*

# --- Test harness -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# A bad change here once pointed the tests at the live database and wiped it.
phpunit.xml*
tests/TestCase.php
tests/Concerns/*

# --- Service worker and web manifest ----------------------------------------------------
# Not written yet; listed now so they start high. A service worker can cache or rewrite
# every page.
public/sw*.js
resources/js/sw*
*.webmanifest

# --- Toolchain --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# composer.json/package.json and the lockfiles are NOT here: they're on the allowlist,
# and risk_tier.py itself flags anything beyond a version bump or any new package.
.npmrc
*/.npmrc
.nvmrc
pint.json

# --- Agent instructions -----------------------------------------------------------------
# An agent PR that edits its own rules is exactly what this gate is for.
.claude/*
*/.claude/*
.gemini/*
*/.gemini/*
.superpowers/*
*[Cc][Ll][Aa][Uu][Dd][Ee]*.[Mm][Dd]
*[Aa][Gg][Ee][Nn][Tt][Ss].[Mm][Dd]
*[Gg][Ee][Mm][Ii][Nn][Ii].[Mm][Dd]

# --- Repo plumbing ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# What git tracks, ignores or pulls in, and what the secret scan skips.
.gitignore
*/.gitignore
.gitattributes
*/.gitattributes
.gitmodules
# The gitleaks rules live at .github/gitleaks.toml (covered by .github/*). This entry
# stays so a root copy, which gitleaks would auto-load locally, is still caught.
.gitleaks.toml
.gitleaksignore

# --- SVG can carry script ---------------------------------------------------------------
*.svg
